name: EgoNeRF
definition: EgoNeRF is an efficient adaptation of NeRF for large-scale scenes with casual input, utilizing a balanced spherical feature grid and maintaining uniform ray hit rates for individual cells for scenes captured with a short video of omnidirectional cameras.
summary: EgoNeRF is an efficient volume rendering method for egocentric video that uses a balanced spherical grid and shared density grid to avoid Cartesian inefficiencies and proposal MLPs.
